newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare Realty signs management pact.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Realty signs management pact.

text.p: Healthcare Realty Trust Inc said Thursday it has signed a real estate asset management agreement with a division of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp for undisclosed terms.
The agreement encompasses 123 properties or leasehold interests in South Florida totaling about 1.6 million square feet of ancillary and medical office space affiliated with 15 hospitals.

Healthcare Realty is to provide full-service, day-to-day property management and strategic asset management on 31 of the properties, and will provide administrative services for tenants with leasehold interest in the remaining 92 properties.
